what: The rendered UI check used the owner dev server already running on the base url, could not show a page in another state, and its evidence was rejected because the server was not its own
rule: The UI check must start its own server on a free port, support pages with several states (query or test route), and count as evidence when it passes on the current code.
fix: start the profile server on a free port with {port}, add mockupQuery and waitFor per screen
